description: The pages a public site is expected to have and a visitor is expected to be able to find. Each one is a small piece of work and a large absence.

gates.title: Privacy, Terms And Contact Exist
gates.rule: All three routes are served. A site collecting an email address without a privacy page is collecting it without saying what happens to it.
gates.fix: Add the routes and write them for this business rather than pasting a template.

gates.title: They Are Linked From The Footer
gates.rule: Each of the three is reachable from the site's own footer. A page that exists and is linked from nowhere is a page nobody finds when they go looking, which is the only time anybody looks.
gates.fix: Add the links to the site footer. This is the site's footer, not the {agency_bar}, which carries no client links.

gates.title: Analytics Comes With A Notice
gates.rule: Where the site loads analytics or any other tracker, a cookie notice is present. Where it loads none, no notice is added: a consent banner on a site that sets no cookies is theatre and costs every visitor a click.
gates.fix: Add the notice, defaulting to the most privacy-preserving option, or drop the tracker.
